These are sewer infrastructure services, not wastewater treatment or kilometre sewer construction. Positive product and conversion-only inputs keep factor +1; negative waste references require factor -1 independently. Retain the original regional supply weights without renormalization. Complete UVEK material and operating suppliers are screening proxies: Swiss/European cement/mortar and concrete blends, cast-iron and steel production mixes, gravel and sand supply, electricity mix, diesel machines, water delivery, full HDPE/PP/emulsion-PVC resin and separate pipe extrusion differ in background, freight, vintage and technology. The exact 3.9.1 and 3.10.1 polyethylene-waste market groups retains its RER/Europe-without-Switzerland/Swiss weights using the existing country-market correspondences; no inheritance from 3.10 and no global polyethylene rule rewrite. These helpers do not establish LCIA equivalence. Preserve the separate reported water releases in cubic metres; native UVEK uses the existing reviewed 1000 kg/m3 correspondence without altering compartments. No real emission is omitted. Score/export all helpers. Preserve caller amounts, uncertainty, formulas, metadata, foreground suppliers, production and separately listed emissions; internal source uncertainty and parameter formulas are not reconstructed.
